title: An empty or short wave plan names why the backlog is not lane material (console kind, console route, protected surface, unmet dependency, no id)
summary: Wave 20 planned nothing launchable from 169 inbox items and nothing said why; the answer took a throwaway diagnostic (162 console-owned, 5 without an id, 2 blocked on console-owned dependencies). Design doc §7.7 W6.
acceptance: LOOP_WAVE_EMPTY_PLAN and a short wave carry counts of pending items by exclusion reason, and the blockers of dependency-waiting items.
The census reads the same lane menu the planner reads (inboxmover.PartitionLaneMenu).
